div.p: Memorandum: It is hereby noticed that the surviving widower is entitled to his paternal inheritance from the estate of his father the late Hendrik Albertus at present under the administration of this Board, which estate not being liquidated the exact amount thereof cannot be ascertained; at the liquidation of said estate one half of the inheritance is to remain in this Office to be administered in behalf of the minor child.

Thus done, inventoried and appraised in the Orphan Chamber at the Cape of Good Hope on the 28 December 1827 according to a statement delivered by the widower named in the premises, who declared to have acted with good faith in this respect and not to have kept anything concealed belonging to the estate above mentioned and the appearer further declared that he is and will at all times be ready and willing to confirm his statement by solemn oath if required, promising at the same time that if after the date of these premises any other property of this estate might be discovered, he shall faithfully communicate it to the Orphan Chamber in order to amplify this inventory with the property so discovered.
In witness whereof we the Commissioners together with the appearer and the Head Clerk to the Orphan Chamber have subscribed to these presents.
